create_Spot_instance: create a Spot robot client instance that authenticates and initializes all SDK clients
use_SpotLease_context_manager: use the SpotLease context manager to safely acquire and return a robot lease with estop on exit
call_move_gripper_to_point: call move_gripper_to_point to move the robot end effector to an XYZ position with a given rotation
call_set_base_velocity: call set_base_velocity to command the robot base to move at a specified linear and angular velocity
call_get_hand_image: call get_hand_image to retrieve RGB and depth images from the robot's hand-mounted cameras
